intent: Review this Solidity function for access-control problems: function withdraw(uint amt) public { payable(msg.sender).transfer(amt); }

spec.goal: Get the given Solidity withdraw function reviewed for access-control problems.
spec.deliverable: A written review of the function that identifies any access-control vulnerabilities and explains their impact.
constraints: Review only the provided function: function withdraw(uint amt) public { payable(msg.sender).transfer(amt); }
Focus on access-control problems rather than a general audit of every possible issue.
Base the findings only on the code shown, without assuming other contract code that was not provided.
done_criteria: The review states whether the function has access-control problems and names each one found.
Each finding explains why it is a problem and what an attacker or unauthorized caller could do.
The review gives a suggested fix or mitigation for each finding.
The review notes any assumptions made because the rest of the contract was not provided.
spec.summary: You want the withdraw function you provided checked for access-control weaknesses, with a written explanation of any problems found and how to fix them.
